```python
import griffe

# Load the requests module using the module-level convenience entry point
module = griffe.load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions
public_functions = [
    name for name, member in module.members.items()
    if not name.startswith("_") and member.is_function
]

print("\n".join(sorted(public_functions)))
```
